Mejiro Ryan ran with reckless abandon on 
the grand stage of the Arima Kinen and 
produced great results.

Acknowledging her strength, Oguri Cap 
exchanged a promise with Mejiro Ryan for a 
rematch on this very stage next year.

Etching the experience from this race into 
her heart, Mejiro Ryan sets her sights on 
the Tenno Sho (Spring) for a rematch with 
Mejiro McQueen!
